messages:
Nora W: Hi everyone, first week! I can view the Notion onboarding hub but can't edit any templates. Where are the canonical templates (first-week checklist, 1:1 agenda, repo access steps) and who exactly do I ask to get edit rights?
Jamie T: welcome Nora :tada: Canonical templates live in the shared workspace 'Redwood Docs' > Templates > Onboarding. We keep a master set (Eng/PM/CS/Ops) there.
Nora W: I found the folder but pages show 'Can view'. The request button opens a generic support ticket. Is there a direct owner or group we should ping?
Rafael (Docs): hey Nora : we have two main flows. For ongoing editing across team pages ask to be added to the SSO group `docs-editors`. That requires an IT form + manager approval. For a one-off change, duplicate the template to your personal workspace, edit, then submit via docs-bot to create a contribution PR.
Maya (People Ops): quick note: If it's a People Ops onboarding template, tag the page with `#people-ops` in your PR so we get auto-reviewed. Also tell your onboarding buddy to review any changes to the official checklist.
Nora W: what's the exact IT form link and the minimum info they need?
Jamie T: IT form: https://forms.redwood.internal/it-access (choose Notion > Contributor). Put your work email, manager name, and note "docs-editors group". ETA is usually 20-60m with manager approv al.
Rafael (Docs): For the contributor PR flow: Duplicate the page (use 'Duplicate with subpages'), tidy the content, then Share > Invite docs-bot@redwood. In the share invite message include a short PR note and `regions:` if it's region-specific. docs-bot will open a GitHub PR to `docs-templates`.
Nora W: Are there naming conventions for templates? Want to avoid creating duplicates.
Rafael (Docs): Yes, please prefix titles with the team tag: e.g., "[SWE] - First Week Checklist" or "[People Ops] - 1:1 Template". Add a one-line summary under the title and a metadata footer with Owner / Last updated / Related repos.
Maya (People Ops): Also avoid creating top-level pages for team docs; always use the Templates > Onboarding folder or indicate it's a private team doc in the PR.
Nora W: If I need to include sensitive onboarding steps (security access, legal forms), is there a special process?
Rafael (Docs): Sensitive content: mark the page with `#sensitive` and include the names of the people who should review (Security, Legal). We will gate those pages; they may become private to a group after review. For service-account keys or secrets we never store values in Notion; link to the secrets manager and record the access workflow only.
Nora W: Got it. One more: can someone add me to docs-editors now? I need to tweak the Eng first-week checklist ASAP. Manager is Maya.
Jamie T: Nora, please post your work email here so IT can process faster.
Nora W: nora.w@redwood.example.com
AccessBot: Received request: Nora W (nora.w@redwood.example.com) -> Notion Contributor (docs-editors). Manager: Maya (People Ops). Current status: pending manager approval.
Maya (People Ops): Approved. Jamie/Taylor (IT) can you process?
Jamie T: pinging IT now in the background, but also Rafael if you want to avoid waiting for group add, duplicate and invite docs-bot; we'll merge the PR and promote the change so it shows up in the canonical location.
Rafael (Docs): I'll keep an eye out for the PR. If you tag it `onboarding: first-week` I'll prioritize review. Also small tip: use the 1:1 template that includes an auto-checklist for repo invites and infra access so the eng manager can sign off.
Nora W: Thanks! I duplicated the Eng first-week checklist and made a few updates. Invited docs-bot with PR note: "tiny wording + add onboarding buddy step".
AccessBot: docs-bot invitation received. Creating PR: #3248 against docs-templates. Notifying Docs Reviewers.
Rafael (Docs): PR seen, will review in a bit. If everything looks good we'll merge and sync the canonical page.
Nora W: Amazing, appreciate the quick help everyone :)
Jamie T: welcome again and glad you got unblocked. If you hit SSO oddities reply here and we'll escalate.
Maya (People Ops): Welcome Nora :sparkles: We'll make sure the onboarding checklist includes a 1:1 with your buddy in week 1.
